dedupe_keys.name: nationell jarnvagsdatabas njdb the swedish national railway database and its open network products

description: The Nationell järnvägsdatabas (NJDB) describes the whole Swedish railway network, including tracks held by Trafikverket, municipalities, Inlandsbanan, Arlandabanan, the Öresund Bridge consortium, ports, industries and other private track owners licensed by Transportstyrelsen. Features are tied to a reference network and include infrastructure manager and owner, track designation, gauge, electrification, train control system, loading gauge, permitted speed, switches, tunnels, bridges, level crossings, platforms, main and side tracks, track status and kilometre posts. It was built by Trafikverket with Transportstyrelsen and is published by Trafikverket. Coverage is national. Ready-made products (railway network with basic properties, with length measurement, with aggregated track sections, generalised traffic places and network status) are free to download from the Lastkajen service as GeoPackage files under CC0, with a web map viewer (NJDB på webb) and WMS; other products, such as data for noise calculations and a generalised network with connections, are delivered on order. Products are updated daily to weekly. Caveats: several products need a free Lastkajen account, some properties are only complete for the state network, and the reference network product specification is sent on request. NJDB supports network flow, capacity planning and hazard exposure studies of Swedish rail, and pairs with Trafikverket's real-time train API and the national road database (NVDB) served from the same portal.
